description: Fetches a public page and runs 24 measurable on-page SEO checks: title and meta description length, H1, heading hierarchy, keyword placement and density, slug, canonical, internal and external links, anchor text, image alt text, schema and social tags. Pass the target keyword to enable the keyword checks. Does not cover rankings or backlinks.

keyword.description: Target keyword or phrase. Optional; without it the keyword checks are skipped.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to check, for example https://example.com/pricing.

name: check_seo_basics
title: Check on-page SEO basics of a URL
